title: Soft but Cones Off Bed
text: Soft but Cones Off Bed. These sheets are really soft and a great color but constantly come off the corners.

product_metadata.title: Bedsure King Size Sheets - Soft 1800 Sheets for King Size Bed, 4 Pieces Hotel Luxury Blue Sheets King, Easy Care Polyester Microfiber Cooling Bed Sheet Set
features: Thoughtful Design: The ruched hem on the pillowcase and top of the flat sheet elevates the elegance of these king size sheets. Available in multiple solid colors, Bedsure sheet & pillowcase sets can easily transform any bedroom into a stylish sleep paradise.

Ultra Soft: Featuring premium polyester microfiber fabric brushed on both sides, these Bedsure bed sheets deliver exceptional softness for restful sleep all year round. Its smooth and breathable fabric provides maximum comfort without crinkling noise.

Enhanced Sturdiness: The premium plain weave adds extra sturdiness and enhanced durability to the 100% polyester microfiber fabric, ensuring the longevity of these Bedsure sheets and keeping them from shrinking and wrinkling. The unique dyeing technique brings out the colors and prevents them from fading.
Skin Safe: This sheet set is Standard 100 by OEKO-TEX certified for meeting the highest testing criteria for harmful chemicals and has been found harmless for humans.

What You Get: This machine washable king sheet set comes with 2 pillowcases (20" x 40"), 1 flat sheet (108" x 102") and 1 fitted sheet (78" x 80"), with full elastic, this sheet can grasp most mattresses up to 16" tightly, keeping it snug without shifting.
